definition: Whether today's range extensions and extremes sit inside or beyond yesterday's value area: buying below yesterday's value is responsive, buying above or within it is initiating, and selling the mirror.
boundaries: Needs yesterday's value area (tpo-value-area-high@1 and tpo-value-area-low@1 on the day before) and today's range extension (initial-balance-range-extension@1); no block joins them yet. Read on a market with a main session; on a 24-hour market the day is the slot the unit binds.
recognition: Initiating selling below yesterday's value reads as conviction to continue lower.

sources.quote: Initiating activity is a stronger form of behavior
